title: Admit the Step 3A compatibility successor with unconditional legacy refusal
author: operator

decision_source.recording_time_basis: created_at/admitted_at is the actual UTC clock observation when materialization began; the original client-message timestamp is unavailable and not inferred from the review, commit or recording time.

supersession_scope: Only the operative legacy permitting/first-success compatibility behavior within admitted 3A. Preserve the historical record and all evidence bytes; do not reclassify historical outcomes. The relation/independence/authority distinction remains.

decision_review.standing: Technical critique of the ChatGPT-authored proposal; not independent adjudication, an APPROVE review, the PI admission itself or permission to merge. GitHub actor metadata does not establish writer–PI separation.

selection_effect: Within admitted 3A, replace the legacy Boolean permitting condition with blocks_adjudication=true unconditionally, including manual construction, production and synthetic calls. Legacy resolve_identity/equivalence without an accepted consumer-pinned context refuses; full-context paths use the complete new pipeline and cannot invoke the old accepting resolver as fallback. A legacy positive resolver projection remains disabled. New refusal reasons are not persisted in IdentityResolution v1. Supplied catalog relation, governed R_identity, necessary Q_identity and Q_C3_C10 stay separate; none grants authority. Production Q_identity stays withheld, and C3/C10/Q_C3_C10 stay unresolved for every 3A domain.
summary: The PI admits only Step 3A at exact r2 under A1–A4. The older decision’s label-based Boolean threshold and unresolved multi-capture path are superseded for new reliance by explicit unconditional legacy refusal plus complete context/source checks. The original decision remains unchanged historical evidence. This record authorizes implementation; it does not assert implemented success, independent adjudication, completion, merge or activation.
rationale: The actual operator instruction supplies the bounded admission after the technical r2 recommendation; a COMMENTED review alone did not admit implementation.

DECISION-20260814-0001 preserved relation versus permission but allowed a false legacy Boolean from two corroborated labels and explicitly deferred multi-source governance. r2 plus A1–A4 now supplies the bounded model/source/witness contract, while no live evidence profile is accepted.

A label, content hash, resolved MID reference or successful fixture is narrower than established identity, independence or authority. Always-blocking legacy compatibility prevents either old assumptions or new synthetic results from becoming a permission path.
The legacy IdentityResolution reason vocabulary is closed and cannot express the new context refusals. A typed new refusal must remain outside that historical record contract.
Deterministic aggregation must retain all relevant adverse evidence and use a total diagnostic order; dictionary insertion order cannot select truth, evidence sufficiency or a permission.
Only 3A is admitted. The 3C distinction between asserted MID equality and affirmative executor equivalence remains deferred and cannot be implemented by analogy.
authorized_effects: Implement 3A D1–D3 under the exact accepted r2 and WARR-20261126-0001 A1–A4, with immediate D8 refusal protection before connecting consumers.
Require exact same-side witness/capture/snapshot/payload/MID and availability linkage; only synthetic model witness conditions can yield the necessary Q_identity subcondition.

Replace old accepting legacy behavior with unconditional Boolean refusal, disabled positive resolver projection and context-bound structured diagnostics. Keep historical reading without authoritatively upgrading old annotations.
Use complete canonical diagnostic bytes as the final sort tie-break and retain all ID/byte conflicts independent of input order.

Replace tests pinning known unsafe behavior with scoped corrected oracles while preserving historical baseline artifacts; retain exact-subject VERIFY and strict assertion-based falsification evidence.
blocked_effects: Do not modify DECISION-20260814-0001 or historical invocation/catalog/annotation/VERIFY/CAS evidence to make new semantics appear historical.
No admission of 3B, 3C, live tool/human binding, SYN-C3-CONFLICT-1 implementation, positive C3/C10 qualification, ontology amendment, superclass or resolved cross-kind rule.
No live model-witness, endpoint-binding, availability, ancestry, tool or human profile is enabled; all six production registries stay empty.
No asserted relation, Q_identity success, PASS label, schema-valid record or GitHub account establishes authority or independent adjudication.
No general catalog writer hardening, credential provisioning, branch protection/ruleset change, merge, whole-PLAN completion or autonomy activation.
Rollback cannot restore first-success R13/R14 behavior or a false legacy Boolean while an affected consumer remains available.
required_next_governance: Obtain scoped implementation review and a separate PI completion decision after exact-subject tests, VERIFY and targeted falsification. This decision is not implementation acceptance or merge permission.
3B and 3C each require later named admission. Before 3C, resolve asserted same-MID versus established same-executor semantics, including unknown release; 3A produces no C3 violation finding.
GAP-0008 coverage/composition and later live evidence rules remain prerequisites for positive qualification; GAP-0005/0008/0010 remain open, writer–PI separation unresolved and Step 5 not ready.
